mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session}
SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND end_user_id=#{user}
SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND agent_id=#{agent}
SELECT DISTINCT agent_id FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND agent_id IN #{agentId}
SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND initiator_member_id=#{member} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{instance}

SELECT tenant_id,test_session_id,slot,capability_type,capability_definition_id,capability_version_id,tool_deployment_id,tool_deployment_key,tool_deployment_revision,knowledge_revision FROM nw_workflow_test_capability_bindings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND test_session_id=#{test} ORDER BY slot
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_workflow_test_sessions SET status='closing',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{test} AND status='ready'
UPDATE nw_workflow_test_sessions SET status='closed',closed_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{test} AND status='closing'
mapper.select: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant}::text AND r.session_id=#{session} AND (r.phase!='FINISHED' OR r.lease_claim_id IS NOT NULL)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_execution_attempts p JOIN agent_runtime_execution_runs r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant}::text AND r.session_id=#{session} AND (p.result_kind IS NULL OR p.result_kind='UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_executions e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant}::text AND e.session_id=#{session} AND e.state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','LOOP_TERMINATED','CANCELLED'))
SELECT FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (status='closing' OR status='ready' AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 50
